title: A Proper Christmas
overview: Nora, a kind-hearted small-town schoolteacher and single mother, is preparing for Christmas when her beloved British grandmother, Iris, arrives for an extended visit. Bringing treasured family traditions, generations of Christmas ornaments, and a knack for matchmaking, Iris quickly becomes a lively presence in Nora’s coastal Southern town.  While visiting the town’s only British pub, Nora meets Jamie, the friendly owner who works hard to keep the family business alive in honor of his late parents. As they spend time together through holiday events, waterfront tea gatherings, and festive community celebrations, a genuine friendship begins to grow into something deeper.
